name: reef
description: Your homelab as an aquarium (/reef): every Docker container is a fish coloured by its stack, unhealthy ones float belly-up, the Ollama GPU is a heater that glows while a model is loaded, Home Assistant is a lighthouse that blinks red with repairs, and a crab walks the sand for each side session at work.

haServer.title: Home Assistant MCP server
haServer.description: As /mcp lists it, or its tool-name spelling; empty leaves the lighthouse dark.

swimmers.title: Animated fish
swimmers.description: At most this many fish swim; the rest hover, which keeps the pane light.
